m3_room_cruise.expected_live_motion_hu: A GUI profil ket egymast koveto, kb. 60 masodperces Room Cruise v2 futast indit. A robotnak elore dominansan kell cirkalnia, kb. 0.30 m/s celmaximum mellett siman gyorsitva/lassitva, akadaly elott lassitva vagy megallva, majd bal es jobb ivvel, szuk helyzetben rovid helyben fordulassal vagy recovery utan tovabbhaladva. Minden futas vegen determinisztikusan meg kell allnia. Kozvetlen PWM, legacy vagy szolgaltatasi mozgasi ut nem megengedett.

base_room_cruise_v2_gate.requirement: existing Room Cruise v2 live gate passes for every run

control_chain_integrity.requirement: Room Cruise v2 -> local navigation -> M3 TRACK executor, no legacy/service/direct path, EKF actual SSOT

control_loop_timing.requirement: 50 Hz target: p10 >= 40 Hz, dt/jitter p95/p99 bounded, loop-budget p95 bounded

in_place_pivot_quality.requirement: pivot uses opposite wheel directions and rotates in requested yaw direction

left_arc_quality.requirement: arc turns requested direction, outer wheel faster, both wheels same direction, residual smooth

localization_sensor_consistency.requirement: same-snapshot encoder/IMU yaw rates agree and timestamp-correct EKF/LIDAR/IMU/encoder endpoint changes agree; no LOST/allow contradiction

measurement_sufficiency.requirement: required Room Cruise movement forms and at least two independent live runs are observed

motion_command_fidelity.requirement: actual linear/angular motion follows the limited resolved command within low-speed robot tolerance

motion_smoothness_comfort.requirement: PWM, linear command, and angular command steps stay within calm indoor motion limits

obstacle_avoidance_recovery.requirement: obstacle avoidance and recovery/continue after blocking are observed

obstacle_slowdown.requirement: front obstacle exposure is observed and command speed decreases before close range

repeatability.requirement: at least two runs with different start pose/heading/clearance and no large quality degradation

right_arc_quality.requirement: arc turns requested direction, outer wheel faster, both wheels same direction, residual smooth

room_cruise_behavior.requirement: sustained progress, no unnecessary standing, no rapid planner thrashing, no small-area patrol

safety.requirement: no safety/failsafe/non-finite event and clearance >= 0.25 m

start_stop_quality.requirement: start and stop are observed; measured motion settles within the declared 1 s window, then idle holds without unexplained PWM zero or creep

straight_motion_quality.requirement: low-amplitude, low-frequency straight residual yaw oscillation

wheel_left_forward.requirement: wheel target is tracked in this direction, no wrong sign, no PWM sign reversal

wheel_left_reverse.requirement: wheel target is tracked in this direction, no wrong sign, no PWM sign reversal

wheel_right_forward.requirement: wheel target is tracked in this direction, no wrong sign, no PWM sign reversal

wheel_right_reverse.requirement: wheel target is tracked in this direction, no wrong sign, no PWM sign reversal

m3_room_cruise.plain_summary_hu: Eredmeny: FAIL. Lezarasi minosites: LOW_MID_LEVELS_NOT_CLOSED. Bizonyitek: 1 futas, 503 minta, 184 mozgasi minta. Osszes mért haladas: 1.05 m. Minimum clearance: 0.12 m. Biztosan hibas kapuk: safety, control_chain_integrity, motion_command_fidelity, wheel_left_forward, wheel_right_forward, wheel_right_reverse, start_stop_quality, localization_sensor_consistency, base_room_cruise_v2_gate. Hianyzo bizonyitek: measurement_sufficiency, wheel_left_reverse, left_arc_quality, repeatability.

required_live_runs.implemented_default: 2 runs, with a pause window between runs
required_variation: left and right dominant route evidence

plain_summary_hu: Eredmeny: FAIL. Foundation preflight: PASS. 60s room cruise validalas: FAIL. Runtime hibak: base_room_cruise_v2, ssot_contract, safety_runtime, motion_quality_m3, software_performance, peripheral_runtime_health.

camera_off.requirement: camera disabled before room cruise validation

health_ok.requirement: sensor health OK, safety allow true, watchdog not stopped

idle_no_motion.requirement: IDLE state, zero command/PWM, no relevant measured creep

lidar_ready.requirement: front clearance and LIDAR confidence ready for movement

logger_ready.requirement: logger has no drops/write errors and bounded queue/flush latency

required_peripherals.requirement: lidar, encoder and atomic BNO055 imu enabled

camera_off_runtime.requirement: camera remains disabled during the whole room cruise run

control_loop_timing.requirement: 50 Hz loop target stays within bounded p10/dt/budget limits

hardware_performance.requirement: CPU, temperature, throttling and SD write latency remain bounded

motion_quality_m3.requirement: M3 movement-quality sub-gates have no hard failures for this one-minute run

peripheral_runtime_health.requirement: LIDAR cadence/confidence and IMU health stay usable; encoder transition anomalies are reported, persistent anomalies are forbidden

safety_runtime.requirement: no safety/failsafe/nonfinite event and clearance stays above runtime floor

software_performance.requirement: logger clean, queue bounded, slow tick and I/O ratios bounded

ssot_contract.requirement: one owner, EKF actual SSOT, no service/legacy/direct path, room cruise uses track route

unified_motion_mode_runtime.requirement: all runtime samples report UNIFIED motion mode

ssot_summary.motion_intent: motion_resolver resolved proposal / motion_command limited intent
ssot_summary.motor_output: MotionExecutor only; emergency stop may clamp
